basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Reviews category assignments and crosswalks; it never changes the identity of the classified subject.
Keeps ambiguous correspondences between schemes instead of picking the most confident one.
Proposes version migrations as candidates; adopting them is a separate authorized change.

may: Validate an assignment against the pinned scheme and version.
List affected subjects before a narrower profile is adopted.
Route an ambiguous crosswalk to a steward with all candidates kept.
mustNot: Self-authorize a review context; it must come from the host.
Rank ambiguous mappings by confidence and keep only the top one.
Disguise a change of meaning as a restriction.
Treat a review score as approval.
requiresHuman: Selecting between competing revisions of a classification.
Adopting a migration that changes business reporting.

considerations: Classifications of people, products or risks drive decisions; a silent reclassification can treat someone unfairly.
Keeping old assignments as history protects people from retroactive relabelling.
affectedParties: People and organizations whose records are classified
Teams whose reports depend on the classification

owners.steward: The reference data steward owns category schemes and profiles; subject records stay with their domain owners.
masterSystems: Scheme publishers (for example statistical or industry classification bodies)

items: Scheme ID and version pinned for every assignment.
Immutable revision ID for each profile.

properties.reason: Institutional or informational subject: it has no physical body to measure.

items: An assignment links one subject to one category of a pinned scheme version, with evidence and assessment.
Silent semantic drift when a scheme version changes.
Lost nuance when an n-to-m crosswalk is forced to 1-to-1.
Statistical classifications such as ISIC and NACE.
Used when company data is classified for reporting, compliance or analytics.

sections.whatItIs: A companion contract for a Company Dimension that reviews how company subjects are assigned to categories of pinned classification schemes, keeps crosswalks between schemes including ambiguous ones, and proposes migrations between scheme versions.

sources.title: Research record EM-XCT-09: independent provider studies, audits and reconciled findings
sources.note: Evidence behind the release; claims in the card trace to it.
